title: Coding-Flashcards belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: ad-si/Coding-Flashcards. Over 1000 flashcards to learn Rust, SQLite, Lua, C, Godot, or Wolfram Language from first principles. Written in markdown with script to convert them to Anki decks or PDF files. It has about 716 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/ad-si/Coding-Flashcards

#GitHub #OpenSource #Developer #Programming #Shorts
